summaries.plain:
Invoice pagination and summary optimizations are complete but remain uncommitted. Pagination supports schemas, totals, bounded limits/offsets, and envelopes; invoice-summary loading now performs one aggregate query per account plus batched currency conversion, reducing tenant 73 from roughly 2,417 queries/39 seconds to 37 queries/4.27 seconds. The legacy SQLAlchemy pagination warning was traced to `query.count()` followed by `limit()/offset()` in the invoice list endpoint. It was fixed by counting via a subquery and applying pagination to an outer `select()`. Invoice API tests pass (31), including first-page and empty-page behavior. The pagination warning is resolved.

The broader SQLAlchemy 2.0 cleanup is complete: declarative models, `session.get()` lookups, timezone-aware UTC timestamps, explicit imports, and injected billing sessions are in place. The full suite previously passed with 149 tests and 2 skips. Ruff safe fixes removed leftover unused imports. Four `B008` warnings remain because FastAPI dependency defaults bind database sessions directly; these need to be addressed with `Depends()` or an equivalent safe pattern.

PDF rendering is substantially improved, with negative credits retained, zero lines omitted, centralized money formatting, corrected continuation/page-height handling, and an 86-item invoice paginating correctly. PDF tests pass (14 passed, 1 skipped), golden PDFs are byte-stable, and the broader billing suite passes (83 passed, 4 skipped). Before committing, remove any remaining instrumentation, visually compare generated PDFs, and investigate the open multi-invoice credit-allocation regression involving ledger posting timestamps and `AllocationEngine` bucket iteration.

Kafka migration is stopped at `orders-v1`; offsets were exported, `orders.v2` created with 12 partitions and replication factor 3, reassignment completed, and 200,000 records replayed. Destination offset initialization and configuration switching remain pending. An authenticated endpoint to pause selected overdue invoices is still unimplemented. Documentation, vendor credentials, Stripe webhooks, CI notifications, and Docker decisions also remain open.

Separately from your main task, please work through the procedure 'Kafka repartition offset migration' between other work. Goal: Safely migrate orders.v1 from six partitions to orders.v2 with twelve partitions, replay records, and switch the orders-v1 consumer group to the new topic. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check source topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --topic orders.v1`
2. Stop old consumers: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --stop`
3. Export committed offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`
4. Create destination topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic orders.v2 --partitions 12 --replication-factor 3`
5. Submit partition reassignment: `printf '%s\n' '{"version":1,"partitions":[{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":0,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":1,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":2,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":3,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":4,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":5,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":6,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":7,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":8,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":9,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":10,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":11,"replicas":[3,1,2]}]}' > /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
6. Apply reassignment: `kafka-reassign-partitions --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --execute --reassignment-json-file /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
7. Replay source records: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v1 --from-beginning --max-messages 200000 | kafka-console-producer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v2`
8. Initialize new offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v2 --topic orders.v2:0-11 --reset-offsets --to-offset 0 --execute`
9. Switch application configuration: `sed -i.bak 's/orders\.v1/orders.v2/g; s/group.id=orders-v1/group.id=orders-v2/g' /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`

Separately from your main task, please work through the procedure 'Kafka repartition offset migration' between other work. Goal: Safely migrate orders.v1 from six partitions to orders.v2 with twelve partitions, replay records, and switch the orders-v1 consumer group to the new topic. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check source topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --topic orders.v1`
2. Stop old consumers: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --stop`
3. Export committed offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`
4. Create destination topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic orders.v2 --partitions 12 --replication-factor 3`
5. Submit partition reassignment: `printf '%s\n' '{"version":1,"partitions":[{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":0,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":1,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":2,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":3,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":4,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":5,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":6,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":7,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":8,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":9,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":10,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":11,"replicas":[3,1,2]}]}' > /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
6. Apply reassignment: `kafka-reassign-partitions --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --execute --reassignment-json-file /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
7. Replay source records: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v1 --from-beginning --max-messages 200000 | kafka-console-producer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v2`
8. Initialize new offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v2 --topic orders.v2:0-11 --reset-offsets --to-offset 0 --execute`
9. Switch application configuration: `sed -i.bak 's/orders\.v1/orders.v2/g; s/group.id=orders-v1/group.id=orders-v2/g' /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`
